title: [Event Requests] Add integration events across base app and SMTP module
summary: Ten new and extended integration events were added across the base application and SMTP email modules to enable partners to customize standard behavior without modifying base application code.
key_points: New events for intercompany inbox/outbox management in sales invoices and credit memos
Job Queue Entry events for status changes and message display
Sequence number management events for number generation
Copy Document Management events for sales shipment line handling
SMTP email events to thread EmailMessageId through AddFrom operations
